items.title: How Salesforce Scaled Engineering AI Adoption Without Stifling Innovation
items.summary: By Paul Constantinides, Anubhav Dhoot and Jackie Chambers de Freitas Salesforce’s Hyperforce Runtime Platform (HRP) engineers were already experimenting with AI. But promising capabilities remained scattered across teams, overlapping efforts competed for limited resources, and tight delivery commitments left little room for another initiative. Scaling AI adoption demanded shared practices; preserving innovation demanded team freedom.
